assets.title: Court trainer
assets.description: Black low-top court trainer, smooth leather upper, black flat rubber cupsole, black laces. Clearly civilian sports shoe, not boot. Same LEFT shoe OUTER SIDE, TOP, SOLE, THREE-QUARTER. Simple original panel seams, no logo.

assets.title: High top trainer
assets.description: Black high-top basketball-style trainer with padded collar, black flat rubber sole, black laces; civilian sneaker, no combat boot features. Same LEFT shoe OUTER SIDE, TOP, BACK, THREE-QUARTER.

assets.title: Zip hoodie
assets.description: Black cotton zip hoodie, hood down, black central zipper, two front pockets, ribbed cuffs and hem. Invisible mannequin, sleeves angled slightly outward. FRONT SIDE BACK and small zipper detail. No person.

assets.title: Puffer jacket
assets.description: Black short quilted puffer jacket with modest horizontal baffles, black zip, hood down, elastic cuffs, no logos. Invisible mannequin, FRONT SIDE BACK, compact hood detail. Casual London streetwear.

assets.title: Gloves
assets.description: Pair of black close-fitting fabric gloves with subtle black palm grip, no armoured knuckles. Show one RIGHT glove BACK OF HAND, PALM, SIDE and relaxed three-quarter, all five fingers clear, plain wrist cuff.

assets.title: Beanie
assets.description: Black rib-knit cuffed beanie, plain unbranded. FRONT SIDE BACK and fabric closeup, on invisible head form. Distinct folded cuff and rounded crown seam.

assets.title: Backpack
assets.description: Small black civilian daypack, soft fabric, two shoulder straps, one main zip and one small front pocket, no tactical webbing. FRONT SIDE BACK plus strap detail.

assets.title: Hood up

assets.title: First person arms
assets.description: Paired first-person avatar forearms and hands wearing black hoodie sleeves and black fitted fabric gloves. Neutral relaxed open hands, PALM VIEW, BACK VIEW and SIDE, separated at sleeve ends. Anatomically plausible fingers, no weapon; intended for later rigging.

assets.title: Handheld radio

assets.title: Supply crate
